meta.title: Eshenbaugh Land Company Comps Database
meta.property_type_cleanup: Investment property type consolidated: unit count = Multifamily, otherwise Land.
meta.geocode_update: Filled missing coordinates using source Excel rows where available, then approximate internal same-street matching from existing mapped comps. Approximate coordinates marked coords_approx=true.
meta.assumptive_geocode_update: Filled remaining missing coordinates using best-available assumptions. Priority: ZIP centroid from existing comps, city centroid from existing comps, inferred city centroid, then broad assumed city/location centroid. All are marked coords_approx=true with geocode_status/geocode_source.

buildout_spreadsheet_import.note: Replaced matching Buildout comps and imported spreadsheet fields including status, acreage, units, photos, coordinates, and supplemental details.

meta.date_added_field: date_added tracks when records were added to this static comp database. Existing records default to 2026-04-30; Buildout spreadsheet batch imported 2026-05-18.

pasco_pa_vacant_land_import.criteria: Pasco County PA vacant sales from Apr 19 2026 through May 19 2026; Sale_Price > 500000; Acres > 0.5; Sale_VacImp = V.
pasco_pa_vacant_land_import.note: Coordinates use Pasco PA public ArcGIS parcel centroids. No-address parcels are labeled by nearest Pasco GIS street name.

hillsborough_pa_vacant_land_import.criteria: Hillsborough County PA vacant sales from Apr 19 2026 through May 19 2026; sale price > 500000; acreage > 0.5; VI = V.
hillsborough_pa_vacant_land_import.consolidation: Parcel sale rows with the same instrument, sale date, sale price, grantor, and grantee were consolidated into one transaction comp with summed acreage and weighted centroid.
hillsborough_pa_vacant_land_import.coordinate_method: Coordinates from official HCPA LatLon_Table_05_15_2026 joined by folio. No-address/0-address display labels use nearest official Hillsborough County hosted road centerline.

link_update.aerial_url_method: HCPA parcel-result hash URL using compact STRAP route ID derived from PIN.
link_update.deed_url_method: Hillsborough Clerk Official Records public index deep link using ?instrument=.

deed_button_update.note: Removed Hillsborough deed buttons by clearing deed_url. Instrument numbers remain in book_page and comments/source records.
